title: Students and Part-Time Jobs
topic: ข่าว/ผลสำรวจ
lines: A survey of 3,000 Thai university students found that nearly half of
**them** have a part-time job. The most common jobs are working in cafés,
tutoring younger students and selling products online. Most students
work between ten and fifteen hours a week.
Money is the main reason. About 60 percent said **they** work to pay for
living costs such as food and transport, while **some** save for travel or
new phones. However, the survey also found a worrying trend: students who
work more than twenty hours a week are twice as likely to fail a course.
Universities are now trying to help. **Several** have created on-campus
jobs with flexible hours, so that students do not have to travel far.
**These** jobs usually pay less than jobs outside, but students say the
time they save is worth more. Experts advise students to treat study as
their main job and to keep part-time work below fifteen hours a week.
